title: 第7章 猫力打工奇观中第8章 猫力打工奇观下
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
白爪黑猫的舌尖，带着细小倒刺的粉嫩，距离那株脆弱得近乎透明的嫩绿猫薄荷，只有毫厘之差！
林墨的心脏在那一瞬间停止了跳动，血液冲上头顶又在下一秒冻结成冰。
他想扑过去，想嘶吼，但极度的虚脱和恐惧死死扼住了他的喉咙，只能眼睁睁看着那致命的舔舐即将落下。
**“喵——？”
**
一声短促、温和，带着安抚意味的喵叫，如同清泉滴落死寂的寒潭，突兀地打破了凝固的绝望。
这声音并非来自猫群，而是源自林墨干裂的嘴唇。
几乎是本能地，在千钧一发之际，他强行压榨出最后一丝力气，调动了系统赋予的【初级猫语精通】！
声音不大，却清晰地传入三只流浪灵猫敏锐的耳中。
**唰！
**
白爪黑猫的舌头猛地僵在半空，距离嫩芽仅剩一丝发丝的距离！
它如同触电般缩回脑袋，金色的瞳孔瞬间收缩成针尖，浑身炸毛，警惕地弓起身体，死死盯住声音的来源——那个趴在泥地上、头顶长着奇怪黑耳朵、身后拖着条脏兮兮尾巴的“同类”
黄狸花猫和三花玳瑁猫也吓了一大跳，齐齐后退一步，喉咙里发出威胁的低吼，琥珀色和淡金色的眼睛里充满了惊疑不定。
它们这才真正注意到林墨的存在，以及他身上那股奇特的、混杂着“同类”
气息又带着些许陌生感的味道。
林墨的心脏在胸腔里狂跳，几乎要破膛而出。
有效！
沟通有效！
他强撑着几乎要散架的身体，艰难地抬起头，让自己的目光尽量显得温和无害，再次尝试着发出一声更清晰、带着明确安抚意图的短促喵音：“喵~”

（别怕，我没有恶意。
这一次，白爪黑猫的炸毛状态稍稍平复了一些，但眼神中的警惕丝毫未减。
它看看林墨，又看看那散发着致命诱惑香气的嫩芽，喉咙里发出低沉的、充满困惑和渴望的呼噜声：“喵…呜？”
（你是谁？这草…好香…想吃…）
林墨捕捉到了这声回应中的关键信息——**想吃！
**
饥饿！
它们和自己一样，都挣扎在饥饿的死亡线上！
而那株嫩芽，是它们无法抗拒的诱惑！
电光火石间，一个大胆的念头在林墨因饥饿和疲惫而混沌的脑海中炸开！
食物！
他还有最后一点食物！
那是他藏在怀里，准备留到撑不下去时才动用的最后一块干硬杂粮饼！
他毫不犹豫地伸出颤抖的手，艰难地探进怀里。
这个动作立刻又引起猫群一阵紧张的低吼和后退。
但他动作很慢，尽量不引起更大的敌意。
他掏出了那块比拳头还小、颜色灰黑、硬得像石头的杂粮饼。
猫群的目光瞬间被这新出现的东西吸引，三双眼睛齐刷刷地盯住了林墨手中的饼，饥饿的光芒几乎要化为实质。
尤其是那只骨架粗壮的黄狸花猫，嘴角甚至不受控制地淌下了一丝透明的涎水。
林墨的心脏在狂跳，他知道自己在进行一场豪赌。

他用尽全身力气，将那块干硬的饼掰下极小极小的一块——只有指甲盖大小。
然后，他极其缓慢地、小心翼翼地将这块饼渣，放在了距离猫薄荷嫩芽足有三尺远的一块相对干净的石头上。
content_en:
The tip of the white-clawed black cat's tongue, pink and tender with tiny barbs, was only a hair's breadth away from the fragile, almost transparent green catnip!
Lin Mo's heart stopped beating at that moment, and the blood rushed to his head and froze into ice the next second.
He wanted to pounce and scream, but extreme exhaustion and fear strangled his throat tightly, and he could only watch helplessly as the fatal lick was about to fall.
**"Meow——?"
**
A short, gentle, soothing meow was like a clear spring dripping into a dead cold pool, suddenly breaking the frozen despair.
The sound did not come from the cats, but from Lin Mo's chapped lips.
Almost instinctively, at the critical moment, he squeezed out the last bit of strength and mobilized the [Elementary Cat Language Proficiency] given by the system!
The sound was not loud, but it reached the keen ears of the three stray civet cats clearly.
**Shua!
**
The white-clawed black cat's tongue suddenly froze in mid-air, only a hair away from the bud!
It retracted its head as if it was electrocuted, its golden pupils shrank to needlepoints in an instant, and its body was covered with hair. It arched its body warily and stared at the source of the sound - that "same kind" lying on the mud with strange black ears on its head and a dirty tail trailing behind it.
The yellow raccoon cat and the calico tortoiseshell cat were also startled. They all took a step back, growling menacingly in their throats, and their amber and light gold eyes were filled with uncertainty.
Only then did they really notice Lin Mo's existence and the strange aura in him that was mixed with "the same kind"
The breath smelled a little strange.
Lin Mo's heart was beating wildly in his chest, almost bursting out of his chest.
efficient!
Communication works!
He forced his body that was almost falling apart, raised his head with difficulty, and tried to make his eyes look as gentle and harmless as possible, and tried again to make a clearer and clearer short meow with the clear intention of comforting: "Meow~"
(Don't be afraid, I don't mean any harm.
This time, the white-clawed black cat's furry state has calmed down a little, but the vigilance in its eyes has not diminished at all.
It looked at Lin Mo, then at the buds exuding the fragrance of fatal temptation, and purred in its throat in a low voice, full of confusion and longing: "Meow...wu?"
(Who are you? This grass... smells so good... I want to eat it...)
Lin Mo captured the key message in this response - I want to eat it!
**
Hungry!
Like themselves, they are all struggling to die from hunger!
And that bud is an irresistible temptation for them!
In the flash of lightning, a bold idea exploded in Lin Mo's mind, which was chaotic due to hunger and exhaustion!
Food!
He still has the last bit of food!
That was the last piece of hard multigrain cake that he hid in his arms and planned to save until he couldn't hold it any longer!
He stretched out his trembling hand without hesitation and reached into his arms with difficulty.
This action immediately caused the cats to growl nervously and retreat.
But he moved slowly, trying not to arouse further hostility.
He took out the piece of multigrain cake that was smaller than his fist, gray-black in color, and as hard as a rock.
The eyes of the cats were instantly attracted by this new thing. Three pairs of eyes stared at the cake in Lin Mo's hand, and the light of hunger almost turned into reality.
Especially the thick-framed yellow tabby cat, with a trace of transparent saliva dripping uncontrollably from the corner of its mouth.
Lin Mo's heart was beating wildly, and he knew that he was making a huge gamble.
He used all his strength to break off the dry and hard cake into a very small piece - only the size of a fingernail.
Then, very slowly and carefully, he placed the piece of cake crumbs on a relatively clean stone three feet away from the catnip buds.
